question: What claim about the source of this teaching must hold if it is said to have been told by the earth-mover concerning the earth-movers who are good eaters?
premises: A teaching concerning the earth-movers who are good eaters is in question.
It has been told by the earth-mover.
inference: The teaching about the earth-movers who are good eaters has been told by the earth-mover to the beloved addressee.
uncertainties: The distinction between the agent bhūcarī and the class bhūcarīṇāṃ is not explicit from this verse alone.
plain_english: O beloved one, the teaching of the earth-movers who are good eaters has been told by the earth-mover.
